title: Trigger Management & Bulk Load Disabling
description: Enable, disable, rename, and drop triggers, and avoid trigger execution during mass data migrations.

data.text: During mass data migrations or initial ETL ingestion, triggers can degrade bulk load performance or fire unintended side effects. PostgreSQL allows disabling and enabling triggers cleanly.

data.title: Disabling Triggers for Bulk Ingestion
data.content: Temporarily disabling triggers on a table.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use `ALTER TABLE ... DISABLE TRIGGER` to pause trigger execution.
Always re-enable triggers immediately after data ingestion completes.
